description: Invented Antigravity CLI first-run sign-in picker: numbered rows under a > highlight and a "↑/↓ Navigate · enter Select" footer. In agy a digit neither picks nor moves the highlight (it is silently dropped), so a menu answer does nothing; the tap must walk it with Down/Up and commit with Enter.
